placement_rules.units: glTF world metres (kitchen root is identity)
placement_rules.door: vertical, per door style (mount.by_door_style[door_style]). Framed styles (shaker_classic, shaker_slide, fusion_shaker, fusion_slide): centreline on the centre of the latch-side stile (stile width / 2 from the edge opposite the hinge); the pull end on the inside edge of the rail (top rail on base doors, bottom rail on uppers); knob on the stile centre at that rail/stile corner. Slab: centreline 2-1/2" (63.5 mm) in from the latch edge, end 2-1/2" from the top (base) / bottom (upper); knob at that corner point. position = anchor + anchor_dir * length/2.
placement_rules.drawer: horizontal; centred on the drawer front (both directions) whatever the length; knobs at the centre.
placement_rules.size_class: doors: small (style's shorter pull). drawers: front width < 14" (356 mm) -> small, >= 14" -> large (style's longer pull).
